title: ACME — Flame Design
scientific_focus: Nonpremixed gaseous flames; soot inception and radiative extinction
objectives: Improve control over flame structure and soot production and study quasi-steady spherical diffusion flames, especially extinction driven by radiation.
approach: Produce gas diffusion flames using interchangeable ACME burner hardware, adjust reactant streams, and document flame geometry, stability, and radiation-related extinction in microgravity.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
